description: LeadProof helps users find real local businesses by category and market directly in ChatGPT. Results can include business names, websites, phone numbers, addresses, ratings, review counts, and available business emails. Users can choose whether they want verified-email-only results, email-required results, a mixed list that prioritizes email coverage while filling the requested quantity with business-only rows when needed, or businesses-only results. Each connected account has a lifetime free allowance of up to 100 delivered leads, with up to 25 leads per search.

defaultPrompt: Find me 10 dentists in Miami with business contact details.
Find me 25 HVAC companies in Phoenix. Prioritize businesses with emails, but fill the list even if some have no email.
How many free LeadProof leads do I have left?
